answer: To identify functional gaps, usability issues, and technical bugs early, before the final product is built, saving time and reducing cost.
prompt: What is the primary purpose of testing a prototype in the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)?

answer: A testing method where the tester has no knowledge of the internal code or logic. Testing is based purely on inputs and expected outputs, checking whether the system behaves correctly from the user's perspective. Also called functional testing.

A testing technique where the tester has full knowledge of the internal code structure, logic, and paths. It verifies that all statements, branches, and conditions execute correctly. Requires programming knowledge and is used during unit and integration testing.

Alpha testing is performed by internal staff (developers/QA team) in a controlled environment before external release. Beta testing is performed by actual end-users in their real-world environment to collect feedback before the official launch.
